name: Drake Rider (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
body:
Dragons are naturally magical, so coveting their power is only rational.

Draconic Companion

The drake rider has a legendary drake companion using their class level to determine its abilities. In addition, they speak the Draconic language. This replaces arcane surge.

Draconic Spells

The drake rider adds the following spells to their spell list as part of the universal affinity:

1st—acid maw
2nd—aquatic cavalry, celestial companion, companion life link, scale spikes, scamper
3rd—bleed for your master, companion mind link, scale spikes, greater, shield companion
4th—share shape, strong jaw, watchful animal
5th—companion transposition, die for your master, raise animal companion
